send.label: Send
send.description: The chat block starts it whenever the person sends a message; its package carries the message and the conversation so far.

outputs.name: Data
outputs.description: What the round was started with: {event, values} -- event is null in a round this start point did not begin.

assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.description: Answers the last message, knowing the conversation so far

reply.label: Reply
reply.description: The assistant's answer: the chat shows it and adds it to the conversation.

inputs.name: Path
inputs.description: Optional: a wired file or folder path, used instead of the one set above.
